`coalesce` returns the first non-null value from a list of fields.  
Example: `| eval SourceIP = coalesce(src_ip, client_ip, source_address)` – useful when same data exists under different field names across sources.

SIEM Best Practices & ES Basics: Normalize data via CIM. Data Models accelerate searches. CIM fields (src, dest, user, action) enable cross-source correlation. Use Asset/Identity to enrich events.

Asset & Identity/Threat Intel: Assets are servers/workstations; Identity is users. Threat Intel frameworks (STIX/TAXII) feed IOCs into ES to match against events.

Detections in ES: Correlation searches that trigger Findings. Can be rule-based or risk-based.

ES Elements: Finding \= detection result. Risk-based Finding \= risk score alerts. Adaptive Response \= automated actions. Entity \= user/host. Intermediate Findings \= contributing events.

Dashboards: Security Posture, Incident Review, Risk Analysis, Asset Investigator, Threat Intel.

Risk-based Alerting: Aggregates risk scores per entity over time. Triggers when threshold crossed.

SOAR: Automated playbooks triggered by Findings or Adaptive Responses.

Triage: Investigate Incident Review → check entities → use Asset/Identity → review findings → escalate or close.
